reported_fitted_or_used.name: Cloudray 80 W laser PSU
reported_fitted_or_used.source_line: In a follow-up the owner says Ruida CN5 pin 1 (GND) goes to Cloudray G&P and to the water-switch circuit; CN5 pin 2 (L-On1) goes to Cloudray L; CN5 pin 3 (LPWM1) goes to Cloudray IN; CN5 pin 4 (WS1) goes to the other water-switch terminal. The forum post also says Cloudray G and P were jumpered in one configuration. The owner reported occasional “Water Error” and inconsistent firing. These are a user's wiring observations on one particular machine and PSU, not a validated generic map.
